name: dawn_alarm_room
character: A small, bright wooden room with a short tail: every plucked and blown note blooms for about three-quarters of a second and is gone before the next hook entry, so the tune stays readable on a phone speaker and the loop point carries no wash.
sources: KB short-form-functional-music (a tail that is still sounding when the next hook enters smears the tune on a small speaker: working rule, per search result for small-speaker mixing guidance)
STARTING VALUE: rt60 0.75 s is about one and a half beats at 120 BPM; every delay and gain here is a starting value for a small room, not a measurement of one
CARRIED OVER from the ringtone project: the same small bright room; a tail still sounding when the next stage's hook enters smears a tune on a small speaker (starting value)
